notes.title: BIOROID CUSTOMIZER CONTEST & APP UPDATE 2021 #3
notes.content:
[h1]CUSTOMIZER CONTEST HIGHLIGHTS[/h1]

Yet another contest has been successfully concluded, with a newcomer among the ranks of Herogrinder champions. [b]ArchElmo [/b]took first and second place place with arctic panda enforcer [url=https://herogrinder.com/api/character/b13a8d663bab8fe9f21123cb9fad471f215d11cb136ff1924c52d4a8378a43e]BigChungus [/url]and sleek street samurai with dual blades [url=https://herogrinder.com/api/character/df4d9ede0214718324b1f4907cde1d010b3a0b038e9949ed0170b71c63934]Moxie[/url]. Thirs place went to returning contestant [b]straylight[/b], with Rus Federation [url=https://herogrinder.com/api/character/9c3f97c8f8061ca2d612da6a21da8fbec26d73ebe7ceda368149d3754f46643]Gunner[/url]. Congrats to the new winner for dominating the arenas!

The race has begun once again! Be sure to share your submissions on social media to collect as many votes as possible and to win a 3D print of your own bioroid!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/a906c28989a26f16f9052c6383097fb29df35677.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/b61fb30249d90dfad91bb8de2f88cb72d994b472.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/9ffdc4b3166390320117f104d7f0e8f2df9f4a63.png[/img]

The race has begun once again! Be sure to share your submissions on social media to collect as many votes as possible and to win a 3D print of your own bioroid!

[h1]A SEE-THROUGH EXPERIENCE[/h1]

While creating our arenas, we have introduced glass walls into our map editor, that can be used for strategic advantages. As for all our walls, there will be three types of hardnesses, with an additional one - the standard plate of glass that shatters upon impact. The main role of glass partitions is to allow the targeting of opponents on the other side, unlike a normal wall. Check out the demos we have created so far:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/2129465ca50eb0979c707d35ce96a52f57b149f0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/cad187b33fec0a6517b2baf951edd05b91ff9ec6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/62a0b046a37a24e118513ef8077f8f20e5a622ca.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/a60bc4cc63870ccf8b862ff4d9fb4a16b8b54635.jpg[/img]

[h1]PRESS STATEMENT: MAKHOV, 2489.05.07.[/h1]
[i]Mr. Khamanec survives 5th assassination attempt[/i]

Ms. Anastasya Lyuba, Personal Assistant to Mr. Igor Khamanec has confirmed that Mr. Khamanec has been unharmed by a blotched attempt on his life by the separatist Tatar Dream Movement in Tsarsky-gorod this morning. Thankfully Mr. Khamanec was inside his custom-armored hovercar when the bomb was triggered and the Makhov protection was perfectly suitable to avoid injury even against the E4-SpiderMines used in the assassination attempt.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/5ad52f5e9b34db4627f80236215a508038538816.png[/img]

notes.title: BIOROID CUSTOMIZER CONTEST & APP UPDATE 2020 #1
notes.content:
[h1]CUSTOMIZER CONTEST HIGHLIGHTS[/h1]
A new Bioroid Customizer Contest has just concluded and we have a winner! Dahn takes the top spot once again dieselpunk enforcer roid [url=https://herogrinder.com/api/character/255cd648ecf30b3af6bd3cb7cdacb662be3a0870c6fab0d3dc60a42e8cb6ede9]JimFingSterlingSon[/url]. gaborg's space punk [url=https://herogrinder.com/api/character/d9e9e89cd9ca6a697fe80cd7ba6bdbc68d88a3d6339ab21a82313f5f2e63a88f]Punkadelic[/url] come in second and Sherry's [url=https://herogrinder.com/api/character/61d27c69c633f5d21236ed3d5b36d0c1ae9fb9c380b86df3d45ce18ec35f42f0]Robocop[/url] in third place. Congrats to all the winners!

The race is on once again! Be sure to share your submissions on social media to collect as many votes as possible and to win a 3D print of your own bioroid!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/10ac407db08e3a246063f07b299e55ef5c75966f.png[/img]

[h1]DEV UPDATE: UPDATE IS FINALLY ALMOST READY![/h1]
Only days remain until the release of the first major update to the Bioroid Customizer App. We just had to put some finishing touches so everything would be perfect. We have loaded it up with some new pieces of equipment to allow for even more customization and variety in character styles. 

Here is the full list of new assets that are coming to the customizer app:
[list]
[*] Auto-shotgun
[*] Mono-knife
[*] Junk armor (light)
[*] Junk armor (medium)
[*] Junk armor (heavy)
[*] Brainout helmet
[*] Balaclava
[*] Baseball cap
[*] Trucker cap
[*] Cigar
[*] Lip piercing x3
[*] Nerve-optics cybereye
[*] Chevron moustache (M)
[*] Old-timer moustashe (M)
[*] Cornrows hair
[*] Weaved hair
[*] Crochet hair (F)
[*] Ska hair (M)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/66d72801c1311df6c95f72fdecaeecdf02143e66.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/c07855545570bc43790bf5455c43ec7baccce23c.jpg[/img]

[h1]NHM NEWSFLASH: INTERNATIONAL[/h1]
[i]Raid on Caliente Technologies HQ[/i]

Policía Federal raided the Caliente Technologies corporate headquarters in Ciudad Juarez, MX and have imponded the company's servers on location. Jorge Guzman, the spokesperson for Caliente has dismissed all allegations that connect the tech-company to the dreaded Aspera Cartel.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/f74c14adcd9bed72ab8b1997a7d9d2dd1a462b83.jpg[/img]

[h1]NHM NEWSFLASH: INTERNATIONAL[/h1]
[i]Zer0Tru claims responsibility for satellite attack[/i]

A member of the W0RM Collective, the hacker known as "Zer0Tru" has claimed responsibility for today's deadly attack on NHM offices in a cyberspace broadcast. Zer0Tru has been wanted by Alliance authorities since 2382 when he crashed every NHM server simultaneously and by the Chinese after the infamous Wuhan Database Wipe in 2385.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/83ddda96bfc643bd448a10c5d7d8db167cf6a557.jpg[/img]

notes.title: BIOROID CUSTOMIZER CONTEST & APP UPDATE 2019 Nov.
notes.content:
[h1]CUSTOMIZER CONTEST HIGHLIGHTS[/h1]
We have just concluded the second monthly Bioroid Customizer Contest! [url=https://herogrinder.com/api/character/f449594d1a767fec03d5444a2443b593f337c64d216029f54ae309521a9f507e]PlasticAcid [/url]took the first place trophy and a 3D pint of the trippy bioroid with a well-deserved votecount of 31, while sexy [url=https://herogrinder.com/api/character/7ba2c97cc4902197c669a36578088e5ebbdfff2be82b8f4e20879e7e69223eef]CompanyExec [/url]came in second and panda-warrior [url=https://herogrinder.com/api/character/9b0f98c8c82fa9c143a39e1b515da7dab1f63eeef91835099db3c2610a31c20e]Lauren [/url]third. But the race has started once again! The third monthly contest is already underway! Be sure to share your submissions on social media to collect as many votes as possible and to win a 3D print of your own bioroid!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/459f143185b5065584ddb9b1b26108ff49c68190.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/b6ff34ee29418bf401ac89763c7d83a553358199.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/897ee479fd216efc2eb86ac799e4195a0330c24d.png[/img]

[h1]CUSTOMIZER APP UPDATE: MONO-KNIFE[/h1]
We are well into constructing the newest weapon and accessory assets for the first update of the Bioroid Customizer app. Another teaser of what we have in store:

Yoroi Technologies presents the latest mono-molecular manufacturing patents to create the most cutting-edge blades. This light weapon is easy to handle and has the highest damage potential in its category, however, due to the ultralight compounds used, it is also easier to miss the target compared to more balanced carbon-steel counterparts. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/f1085df1728763e95c61e95c93383cf107cb2e1d.jpg[/img]

[h1]HEROGRINDER BIOROID USER MANUAL[/h1]
If you haven't already, check out the complete [url=https://herogrinder.com/downloads/Herogrinder%20Bioroid%20User%20Manual.pdf]Herogrinder User Manual[/url], featuring general product specifications for all bioroid combat models.The manual includes 20 preset conditioning progressions that can be used for easy level advancement instead of contestant-specified full customization options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/b32e1c0650bd6a24cd3c89bc3b1f45b508e17c2f.png[/img]

[h1]NHM NEWS - POLITICS[/h1] Anahita atrificial archipelago declares independence

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/36bdfac832cea026f7325145a9e06ec3b5698d3a.png[/img]

The state-of-the-art artificial archipelago, Anahita declared independence from the Collective Arab Emirates. Anahita was originally built as part of a larger project to boost tourism to the Emirates, but it slowly became a hotbed for arcology experiments. Turned into a self-sustainable, ecologically low-impact human habitat, managed by an autonomous A.I., Anahita and its population of 19,704 is now a sovereign island state.

notes.title: BIOROID CUSTOMIZER CONTEST & APP UPDATE
notes.content:
[h1]CUSTOMIZER CONTEST HIGHLIGHTS[/h1]
The first monthly Herogrinder Bioroid Customizer Contest has concluded and we can announce the winner: [url=https://herogrinder.com/api/character/b0b94015669bc052822aa61f81a8387c760cb6a72fa10a82841b0002b6a047b8]ClockworkOrange [/url] with 48 votes. Second place went to winter warrior [url=https://herogrinder.com/api/character/3c57f580d0fba0f6fcad0fabf2e6dd2cfe0ef4547ed913733c2829f1a8dfb13b]MotherRussia [/url]by [i]Xomma [/i]and the panda [url=https://herogrinder.com/api/character/9c7be0ce0af415f8f66b801d58a98358e18a62463af96d603935b120c53d58f1]spacecowboy [/url]by [i]horrorfromthevoid [/i]clinched third place. Congrats to the winners! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/d66ae9acc48ff2cfdd0374cda8b63893422a9c3c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/895746cdbb5a4011fec1b1563cf1cd3ecc6dfddc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/2988279e9e376f4b9bf6e854c41bea5be547e439.png[/img]

Just as the last contest has ended, the new contest has already begun! You can enter up to 8 custom bioroids during the month and be sure to share your submissions on social media and to keep collecting votes so you may win a 3D print of your own bioroid!

[h1]CUSTOMIZER APP UPDATE: 13" MB AUTO-SHOTGUN[/h1]
We are already busy constructing the newest hardware and cosmetics assets for the first update of the Bioroid Customizer app. Just a teaser of what's to come:
 
Meet the 13" MB Auto-shotgun from Armatech Corporation! This magnificent piece of weaponry is a great option for those who favor short to medium range combat and wish to deliver as much damage as possible. The chamber fits 12 rounds of ammunition, which will quickly get used up since the weapon only fires bursts of 3 rounds. Best used in combination with burst firing mode conditioning programs and rapid reload capabilities. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/6968ffe37bd90cff0139c23f678ee1e12aa5294e.png[/img]

[h1]HEROGRINDER EQUIPMENT CATALOG[/h1]
If you haven't already, check out the complete [url=https://herogrinder.com/downloads/Herogrinder%20Equipment%20Catalogue.pdf]Herogrinder Equipment Catalog[/url], featuring all tech suppliers of the Herogrinder gameshow, like MediCore Pharmaceuicals, Yoroi technologies, Armatech Corporation, Makhov Industries, Wuhan Biomedical, Krass Nanotronics Gmbh, Stellar Dynamics, and Carlton Applied Cybernetics.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/51dd2c4104ecd4c58ba08f7672881e98fabe12b4.png[/img]

[h1]NHM NEWS - Toronto Arena[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685129/36bdfac832cea026f7325145a9e06ec3b5698d3a.png[/img]
The demilitarized zone around the free city of Toronto saw a few low scale military skirmishes two years ago. Since then, the strip has been a burnt-out no man's land. Herogrinder Corporation acquired rights to develop the zone and turn it into a street combat Arena. "Herogrinder is renowned for urban combat arenas. And what better place to wage war than on a warfield." stated Jane Allyson, Herogrinder, Inc..
